    # Copy the regression configuration in a special folder, so all autogenerated
    # folders end up in the same place after running regression.
    add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/regression.cfg
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy
                    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/regression.cfg
                    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/regression.cfg
            MAIN_DEPENDENCY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/regression.cfg
            COMMENT "Copying regression.cfg regression file"
    )

    # Create a new target which copies all regression files
    # Subdirectory targets will add themselves as dependencies
    add_custom_target(regression_files
            ALL  # this is needed because 'make test' doesn't resolve dependencies, and otherwise this is never executed
            DEPENDS
            ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/regression/regression.cfg
    )

    # Create a new target which runs the regression
    # Subdirectory targets will add themselves as dependencies
    add_custom_target(regression)

    add_subdirectory(regression)
    add_subdirectory(stationlist)

    # ---- E2E Lifecycle Tests ----
    # These tests verify the game doesn't crash during common operations:
    # new game generation, savegame loading, different landscapes/sizes.
    # Each test runs headlessly with -vnull and checks for crash logs.
    # The GfxFillRect variant crash (genworld_gui.cpp preview) was caught
    # this way after being missed by unit tests.
    #
    # Render-aware smoke tests are available as an opt-in layer on top.
    # They need a real video driver and may open a window, so keep them
    # disabled by default and only enable them on machines meant to run GUI tests.

    set(OPENTTD_LIFECYCLE_RENDER_DRIVER "" CACHE STRING
        "Optional video driver for render-aware lifecycle smoke tests (for example: win32-opengl or sdl2-opengl). Leave empty to disable.")
    set(OPENTTD_LIFECYCLE_RENDER_RESOLUTION "1280x720" CACHE STRING
        "Resolution to use for optional render-aware lifecycle smoke tests.")

    # Copy lifecycle config files to build directory
    set(LIFECYCLE_CFGS
        lifecycle lifecycle_temperate lifecycle_arctic lifecycle_tropic lifecycle_toyland
        lifecycle_large lifecycle_arctic_large lifecycle_tropic_large
        lifecycle_many_rivers lifecycle_flat lifecycle_many_towns lifecycle_long_run
        lifecycle_shape_island lifecycle_shape_archipelago lifecycle_shape_fjords
        lifecycle_shape_scattered lifecycle_shape_peninsula lifecycle_shape_mesa
        lifecycle_shape_volcanic lifecycle_improved_perlin
        lifecycle_biome_arctic lifecycle_biome_tropic
        lifecycle_tiny lifecycle_asymmetric lifecycle_lakes_mountains
        lifecycle_high_sea lifecycle_mountainous
        lifecycle_all_features lifecycle_arctic_all_features lifecycle_tropic_all_features
        lifecycle_endurance
        lifecycle_with_ai lifecycle_water_world lifecycle_voronoi_towns
        lifecycle_max_everything lifecycle_minimum lifecycle_toyland_large
        lifecycle_no_freeform lifecycle_alpine_arctic lifecycle_tropic_rivers
        lifecycle_shape_island_arctic lifecycle_marathon
        lifecycle_seed_13 lifecycle_seed_37 lifecycle_seed_42 lifecycle_seed_100
        lifecycle_seed_256 lifecycle_seed_999 lifecycle_seed_12345 lifecycle_seed_65535
        lifecycle_tropic_seed_7 lifecycle_tropic_seed_42
        lifecycle_tropic_seed_314 lifecycle_tropic_seed_777
        lifecycle_shore_stress_1337 lifecycle_shore_stress_2024
        lifecycle_shore_stress_31415 lifecycle_shore_stress_54321
        lifecycle_shore_stress_98765
        lifecycle_pp_enabled
    )
    foreach(CFG ${LIFECYCLE_CFGS})
        add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${CFG}.cfg
                COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy
                        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${CFG}.cfg
                        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${CFG}.cfg
                MAIN_DEPENDENCY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${CFG}.cfg
                COMMENT "Copying ${CFG}.cfg"
        )
        list(APPEND LIFECYCLE_CFG_FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${CFG}.cfg)
    endforeach()
    add_custom_target(lifecycle_cfg ALL DEPENDS ${LIFECYCLE_CFG_FILES})

    # Helper macro to add a lifecycle test (100 ticks default).
    macro(add_lifecycle_test TEST_NAME)
        add_lifecycle_test_ticks(${TEST_NAME} 100 ${ARGN})
    endmacro()

    # Helper macro with custom tick count.
    macro(add_lifecycle_test_ticks TEST_NAME TICKS)
        add_test(NAME lifecycle_${TEST_NAME}
                COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
                        -DOPENTTD_EXECUTABLE=$<TARGET_FILE:openttd>
                        -DOPENTTD_BUILD_DIR=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}
                        -DEDITBIN_EXECUTABLE=${EDITBIN_EXECUTABLE}
                        -DLIFECYCLE_TEST=${TEST_NAME}
                        -DLIFECYCLE_TICKS=${TICKS}
                        "-DOPENTTD_ARGS=${ARGN}"
                        -P "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/scripts/LifecycleTest.cmake"
                WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}
        )
    endmacro()

    # Optional GUI-backed smoke tests that render a real frame and exit via
    # a per-test game_start.scr in an isolated working directory. These are
    # intentionally few and targeted at draw-path regressions that -vnull misses.
    macro(add_lifecycle_render_test TEST_NAME)
        add_lifecycle_render_test_ticks(${TEST_NAME} 100 ${ARGN})
    endmacro()

    macro(add_lifecycle_render_test_ticks TEST_NAME TICKS)
        if(OPENTTD_LIFECYCLE_RENDER_DRIVER)
            add_test(NAME lifecycle_render_${TEST_NAME}
                    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
                            -DOPENTTD_EXECUTABLE=$<TARGET_FILE:openttd>
                            -DOPENTTD_BUILD_DIR=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}
                            -DEDITBIN_EXECUTABLE=${EDITBIN_EXECUTABLE}
                            -DLIFECYCLE_TEST=render_${TEST_NAME}
                            -DLIFECYCLE_TICKS=${TICKS}
                            -DLIFECYCLE_VIDEO_DRIVER=${OPENTTD_LIFECYCLE_RENDER_DRIVER}
                            -DLIFECYCLE_RESOLUTION=${OPENTTD_LIFECYCLE_RENDER_RESOLUTION}
                            "-DOPENTTD_ARGS=${ARGN}"
                            -P "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/scripts/LifecycleTest.cmake"
                    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}
            )
            set_tests_properties(lifecycle_render_${TEST_NAME} PROPERTIES LABELS "lifecycle;render_smoke")
        endif()
    endmacro()

    # New game generation - all 4 landscapes at 128x128 (fast)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_temperate -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_temperate.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_arctic    -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_arctic.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_tropic    -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_tropic.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_toyland   -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_toyland.cfg)

    # New game generation - 1024x1024 maps (stress test, all climates)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_large          -g -G 42 -c regression/lifecycle_large.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_arctic_large   -g -G 42 -c regression/lifecycle_arctic_large.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_tropic_large   -g -G 42 -c regression/lifecycle_tropic_large.cfg)

    # Edge case: many rivers (exercises river/delta generation)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_many_rivers    -g -G 7  -c regression/lifecycle_many_rivers.cfg)

    # Edge case: flat map (exercises flat terrain code paths)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_flat           -g -G 1  -c regression/lifecycle_flat.cfg)

    # Edge case: high density towns + industries (exercises placement code)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_many_towns     -g -G 1  -c regression/lifecycle_many_towns.cfg)

    # Multiple different seeds (catches seed-dependent crashes)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_seed_0         -g -G 0  -c regression/lifecycle_temperate.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(newgame_seed_max       -g -G 4294967295 -c regression/lifecycle_temperate.cfg)

    # Long run: 1000 ticks to exercise game loop stability
    add_lifecycle_test_ticks(long_run_1000ticks 1000 -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_long_run.cfg)

    # Continent shapes (each exercises different mask algorithms in tgp.cpp)
    add_lifecycle_test(shape_island       -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_shape_island.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(shape_archipelago  -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_shape_archipelago.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(shape_fjords       -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_shape_fjords.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(shape_scattered    -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_shape_scattered.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(shape_peninsula    -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_shape_peninsula.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(shape_mesa         -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_shape_mesa.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(shape_volcanic     -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_shape_volcanic.cfg)

    # Terrain algorithm variant
    add_lifecycle_test(improved_perlin    -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_improved_perlin.cfg)

    # Biome system (temperature-based snow/desert)
    add_lifecycle_test(biome_arctic       -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_biome_arctic.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(biome_tropic       -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_biome_tropic.cfg)

    # Map size edge cases
    add_lifecycle_test(tiny_64x64         -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_tiny.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(asymmetric_512x64  -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_asymmetric.cfg)

    # Combined terrain features (lakes + mountains)
    add_lifecycle_test(lakes_mountains    -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_lakes_mountains.cfg)

    # Difficulty/terrain type variations
    add_lifecycle_test(high_sea           -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_high_sea.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(mountainous        -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_mountainous.cfg)

    # All features combined (stress tests for generation pipeline)
    add_lifecycle_test(all_features       -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_all_features.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(arctic_all_feat    -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_arctic_all_features.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(tropic_all_feat    -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_tropic_all_features.cfg)

    # Endurance run: 5000 ticks exercises economy, town growth, vehicle ticks
    add_lifecycle_test_ticks(endurance_5000 5000 -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_endurance.cfg)

    # Multiple seeds with all features (catches seed-dependent generation bugs)
    add_lifecycle_test(all_feat_seed_99   -g -G 99  -c regression/lifecycle_all_features.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(all_feat_seed_777  -g -G 777 -c regression/lifecycle_all_features.cfg)

    # Water-heavy map (exercises water generation, coasts, rivers)
    add_lifecycle_test(water_world        -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_water_world.cfg)

    # Voronoi town placement (exercises Lloyd relaxation)
    add_lifecycle_test(voronoi_towns      -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_voronoi_towns.cfg)

    # Maximum everything (all generation features maxed out)
    add_lifecycle_test(max_everything     -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_max_everything.cfg)

    # Minimum everything (no towns, no industries, flat, tiny)
    add_lifecycle_test(minimum            -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_minimum.cfg)

    # Toyland large (unique code paths for candy terrain)
    add_lifecycle_test(toyland_large      -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_toyland_large.cfg)

    # With AI player configured (exercises AI startup)
    add_lifecycle_test(with_ai            -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_with_ai.cfg)

    # Freeform edges disabled (changes tile 0,0 handling)
    add_lifecycle_test(no_freeform        -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_no_freeform.cfg)

    # Alpine arctic with biome model (high terrain + snow line calculation)
    add_lifecycle_test(alpine_arctic      -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_alpine_arctic.cfg)

    # Tropic with max rivers + biome (delta generation + desert zones)
    add_lifecycle_test(tropic_rivers      -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_tropic_rivers.cfg)

    # Island shape on arctic with biome (shape mask + temperature-based snow)
    add_lifecycle_test(shape_island_arctic -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_shape_island_arctic.cfg)

    # Marathon endurance: 10000 ticks (~5 min game time)
    add_lifecycle_test_ticks(marathon_10000 10000 -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_marathon.cfg)

    # Seed sweep: temperate with rivers + sea (exercises river/delta/shore interaction
    # across many seeds to catch seed-dependent crashes like the flat shore assert).
    add_lifecycle_test(seed_13    -g -G 13    -c regression/lifecycle_seed_13.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(seed_37    -g -G 37    -c regression/lifecycle_seed_37.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(seed_42    -g -G 42    -c regression/lifecycle_seed_42.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(seed_100   -g -G 100   -c regression/lifecycle_seed_100.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(seed_256   -g -G 256   -c regression/lifecycle_seed_256.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(seed_999   -g -G 999   -c regression/lifecycle_seed_999.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(seed_12345 -g -G 12345 -c regression/lifecycle_seed_12345.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(seed_65535 -g -G 65535 -c regression/lifecycle_seed_65535.cfg)

    # Seed sweep: tropic with rivers + biome (exercises delta + desert interaction).
    add_lifecycle_test(tropic_seed_7   -g -G 7   -c regression/lifecycle_tropic_seed_7.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(tropic_seed_42  -g -G 42  -c regression/lifecycle_tropic_seed_42.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(tropic_seed_314 -g -G 314 -c regression/lifecycle_tropic_seed_314.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(tropic_seed_777 -g -G 777 -c regression/lifecycle_tropic_seed_777.cfg)

    # Shore stress: 512x512 maps with rivers + lakes + sea (regression guard
    # for flat shore assertion in water_cmd.cpp and river delta issues).
    add_lifecycle_test(shore_stress_1337  -g -G 1337  -c regression/lifecycle_shore_stress_1337.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(shore_stress_2024  -g -G 2024  -c regression/lifecycle_shore_stress_2024.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(shore_stress_31415 -g -G 31415 -c regression/lifecycle_shore_stress_31415.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(shore_stress_54321 -g -G 54321 -c regression/lifecycle_shore_stress_54321.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_test(shore_stress_98765 -g -G 98765 -c regression/lifecycle_shore_stress_98765.cfg)

    # PP enabled during generation (exercises FBO setup + shader init during game init)
    add_lifecycle_test(pp_enabled -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_pp_enabled.cfg)

    # Load the existing regression test savegame (verifies save/load path)
    add_lifecycle_test(load_save -g ai/regression/test.sav -c regression/lifecycle.cfg)

    # Opt-in render-aware smoke coverage for shore/water-heavy worldgen paths.
    add_lifecycle_render_test(water_world    -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_water_world.cfg)
    add_lifecycle_render_test(tropic_rivers  -g -G 1 -c regression/lifecycle_tropic_rivers.cfg)
